title: Rematch round 3, Skippy Core's coder: lost to Haiku's round 3 train
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8) as a vanilla agent (Claude Code with purple's system prompt, an empty setup, effort high, a 131K window) plus purple's generic help: eyes (Core's vision model describes the pictures it opens) and the stop gate's work check (MineBench's runtime as the checker, the renderer as the viewer, an 80K output-token budget)
verdict: Lost to Haiku's head-to-head round 3 build (blind judge, high confidence). 45 minutes, 58 turns, shown its picture three times (each time it reworked the ground, ending with dirt and grass patches). The judge: a tiny pale grey locomotive with a light smoke puff and red and dark-blue coaches with window strips, beside a long grey platform, on a huge, mostly empty dirt plane with scattered trees, a dotted white oval and a lone pillar; the locomotive-plus-coaches shape is sensible, but at this scale there are no wheels, rails or cab to make out, and the scene looks unfinished. Haiku's: a black locomotive with a red cab, red wheels and a big smoke plume on a track by a red station, in a landscape with a river and snowy mountains.
